learning_outcomes.text: Can calculate levels of different signal types.
Know measurement procedures including digital data acquisition and their frequency analysis.
Can translate noise protection requirements into acoustic measurement quantities.
Know the psychoacoustic effect of sound.
Understand sound propagation in motor vehicles and its reduction.
Understand the effect of sound insulation and absorption in the vehicle.
Know the experimental quantification of drive, rolling, and wind noises.
Understand the contributions of vehicle components to overall vehicle acoustics.
Recognize differences between electric and internal combustion vehicles.

syllabus_topics: Mathematical description with partial differential equations
Engine noise for electric and internal combustion drives
Legal basis: Exterior noise regulations, AVAS
assessment_rules: Bonus points up to 10% of the examination performance can be achieved during the semester's courses.
